common.tagline: A community food-lifecycle platform: track freshness, share surplus, handle waste responsibly.

landing.heroTitle: Never let good food go to waste.
landing.heroSubtitle: Track freshness in your kitchen. Share surplus before the clock runs out. Rescue meals and redirect organic waste with dignity.

chapter1.title: Freshness & Tracking
chapter1.desc: Track expiry windows, prevent kitchen waste, and receive alerts before shelf-life expires.

chapter2.title: Community Surplus Sharing
chapter2.desc: Homes, caterers, and events list fresh surplus within a strict 48-hour availability window.

chapter3.title: Verified Organisation Network
chapter3.desc: Trusted NGOs and community partners coordinate handovers through verified pickup codes.

chapter4.title: Responsible Waste Cycles
chapter4.desc: Compost, animal feed, and recycling drop-off guides when food can no longer be consumed.
